definitions.gloss: becoming severe; progression to serious illness
definitions.explanation: Of an illness or a patient: turning from mild into a serious condition. A word of medical news and public-health advice, much used during the COVID-19 pandemic.

examples.japanese: ⟦{症状|しょうじょう}→症状：03234_shoujou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{重症化|じゅうしょうか}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{高齢者|こうれいしゃ}→高齢者：15649_koureisha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{重症化|じゅうしょうか}しやすい。
examples.english: Elderly people are more likely to become seriously ill.

examples.japanese: ⟦ワクチン→ワクチン：05074_wakuchin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{感染|かんせん}→感染：05977_kansen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{防|ふせ}ぐ→防ぐ：02409_fusegu⟧⟦だけでなく→〜だけでなく：18373_dakedenaku⟧{重症化|じゅうしょうか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{防|ふせ}ぐ→防ぐ：02409_fusegu⟧⟦{効果|こうか}→効果：02726_kouka⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Vaccines not only prevent infection but also keep it from becoming severe.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {重症化|じゅうしょうか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{防|ふせ}ぐ→防ぐ：02409_fusegu⟧: to prevent severe illness
- {重症化|じゅうしょうか}⟦リスク→リスク：06752_risuku⟧: risk of severe illness
- {重症化|じゅうしょうか}しやすい: prone to becoming severe

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{悪化|あっか}→悪化：11077_akka⟧: worsening — the general word, of anything
- ⟦{重症|じゅうしょう}→重症：09792_juushou⟧: a serious illness or condition (the state, not the change)
